ledger.x: c. 1800: the kingdom forms with the unification of Bora Bora island in the early 19th century; the page gives no exact date.
1888-1895: France annexes the kingdom (19 March 1888); the last ruler abdicates 21 September 1895 and a French vice-resident replaces the queen.
